# MACE - Multi-Agent Committee Evaluator

> MACE is an explainable, multi-agent AI hiring evaluation and adversarial adjudication platform powered by Google Gemini 3.7 Flash. It coordinates four independent specialist agents (Technical Architect, Culture & Behavioral, Hiring Manager Lead, and Risk Auditor) through multi-turn dialectical debate, evidence verification, and non-averaging adjudication.

## Core Capabilities

- [Adjudication Dossier](/): Evidence-weighted synthesis of candidate qualifications, hiring recommendations, confidence scores, and calibrated risk assessments.
- [Independent Agent Panel](/): Isolated evaluations by Technical Architect, Culture Lead, Hiring Manager Lead, and Risk Skeptic without groupthink bias.
- [Voice Debate Arena](/): Turn-based adversarial dialectic where agents challenge claims, defend hypotheses, and calibrate positions using audio synthesis.
- [Evidence Repository](/): Ground-truth citation index linking claims directly to verified lines and snippets in resumes and official transcripts.
- [Contradiction Analysis](/): Cross-document verification highlighting discrepancies between self-reported resume claims and official academic records.

## Architecture & Integration

- [Gemini 3.7 Flash Backend](/api/health): Server-side LLM processing pipeline for document extraction, agent reasoning, and multi-turn debate simulation.
- [Firebase Persistence](/): Secure Firestore database integration with role-based security rules and OAuth authentication.
- [Accessibility & Keyboard Navigation](/): WCAG AA compliant interface with complete keyboard shortcut navigation and screen reader support.
